get.description:
Get a collection of `Asset` objects.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Asset` objects will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

*Get a `Asset` object by ID*.
Only `Asset` object will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_asset_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Asset` object to get

patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `Asset` object identified by ID*.
Only `Asset` object will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_asset_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Asset` object to modify/update

202.description: Successfully accepted the modification of `Asset` object

delete.description:
*Delete a `Asset` object by ID*.
Only `Asset` object will be deleted that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_asset_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Asset` object to modify/update
